findings.evidence: Completion.lean:296 fixes `[UniformSpace B] [T0Space B]`; `UniformSpace.to_regularSpace` (mathlib Topology/UniformSpace/Separation.lean:114) plus `instT3Space`/`T3Space.t25Space`/`T25Space.t2Space` (mathlib Topology/Separation/Regular.lean:410,416,371) give `T2Space B`, so the `[Semiring B] [TopologicalSpace B] [T2Space B]` hypotheses of `hom_ext_toCompletionLoc` (line 338) are met by that target.
findings.fix: Move `hom_ext_toCompletionLoc` above `existsUnique_continuous_ringHom_completion_locTopology` (it has no dependency on it), hoist the first bullet's `(extensionHom f hfc).comp (toCompletionLoc …) = φ` into a `have hext`, and replace the whole uniqueness branch with `exact hom_ext_toCompletionLoc P T s S hden g _ hgc UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_extension (hge.trans hext.symm)`.
findings.issue: The uniqueness half of `existsUnique_continuous_ringHom_completion_locTopology` (lines 317-329: the `hcomp`/`hcoe`/`Completion.extension_unique` dance) is exactly the special case of the new `hom_ext_toCompletionLoc` at `g` and `extensionHom f hfc`, yet the PR adds the general lemma and leaves the duplicate in place in the same file.

findings.evidence: Lines 409-413: `rw [RingHom.comp_assoc, hgc, hhc]; exact hkc` then `hom_ext_toCompletionLoc P T s S hden k (h.comp g) hk (hh.comp hg) hcomp` — the only appeal is to the ext lemma at the source, whose target hypothesis is `[Semiring B] [TopologicalSpace B] [T2Space B]` (line 339).
findings.fix: State it for `{B C : Type*} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [CommRing C] [TopologicalSpace C] [T2Space C]` with structure maps `ιB : A →+* B`, `ιC : A →+* C`, hypotheses `g.comp (toCompletionLoc …) = ιB`, `h.comp ιB = ιC`, `k.comp (toCompletionLoc …) = ιC`, concluding `k = h.comp g`; the three-presentation statement is then the instantiation at `ιB := toCompletionLoc P T' s' S' hden'`, `ιC := toCompletionLoc P T'' s'' S'' hden''`.
findings.issue: `eq_comp_of_comp_toCompletionLoc` forces the middle and target objects to be completed localisations `A⟨T'/s'⟩`, `A⟨T''/s''⟩` of the same `P`, carrying `S' S''`, their `IsLocalization.Away` instances and `hden'`/`hden''`. The proof (lines 409-413) uses none of that: only `T2Space` on the target and ring homs `A →+* B`, `A →+* C` are needed. As stated the composition law cannot be used when the target is an arbitrary complete Hausdorff Huber ring — the exact shape of the universal property two declarations above it in this same file.

summary: The new hypothesis-free extensionality lemma is at the right level and fixes the prior round's over-strong hypotheses, but the PR leaves the bespoke uniqueness argument in `existsUnique_continuous_ringHom_completion_locTopology` — now a strict special case of it — untouched, and the composition law is stated only for three completed localisations though its proof uses nothing about the middle and target objects beyond Hausdorffness.
